system.description:
Prerequisites: Basic Animalism, Advanced Protean. This practical Discipline allows an anarch to discreetly clean up spilled blood — hers or another's — by touching a pool of blood and absorbing it like a sponge at a rate of one Blood Trait per turn, up to her maximum Blood Trait pool. It requires a successful Mental Test against a difficulty of six Traits, retested with Subterfuge or Scrounge. The Storyteller determines how much blood a given pool can yield. The process is imperfect: faint stains remain and any bloodless corpses left behind still constitute a serious Masquerade breach unless further cleaned by mundane means.

Costs 5 Experience Traits to learn.
system.duration: One turn per Blood Trait absorbed
